findings.title: Receipt-state test survives a wrong persisted after-version timestamp
findings.reason: Root rejects RT-001: the selected receipt-state test at src/lib/agents/operator/__tests__/apply.integration.test.ts:440 tests VoiceState/preview divergence, while src/lib/agents/operator/__tests__/apply.integration.test.ts:300-302 already asserts the receipt after-version timestamp equals the actual database timestamp. The timestamp mutant targets a different behavioral contract; it proves neither a fake state test nor a product regression.
findings.arbiter_reasoning: The live-DB test executes successful voice Apply and receives the persisted Receipt. The mutation replaces updatedAt: facts.updatedAt at apply.ts:315 with the fixed nonempty timestamp 2000-01-01 00:00:00+00. buildVoiceReceipt at apply.ts:852-855 passes that value to computeVoiceVersionToken; version-token.ts:45-49 returns it unchanged, and recordApplied stores the resulting Receipt in the transaction. This is an executed production value, not a mock argument. The test asserts receipt.after, differsFromPreview, applied status and the actual written tone, but never compares receipt.versionToken.after.updatedAt with the committed business timestamp. Both single-test baseline and mutant passed. A year-2000 after token is semantically different from the current write timestamp, so the mutation is neither equivalent nor on an unexecuted branch. This exposes a pre-existing assertion gap in an unchanged covering test, not a demonstrated behavior regression in the refactor: unmutated HEAD still forwards the correct writer timestamp. Root adjudication: Root rejects RT-001: the selected receipt-state test at src/lib/agents/operator/__tests__/apply.integration.test.ts:440 tests VoiceState/preview divergence, while src/lib/agents/operator/__tests__/apply.integration.test.ts:300-302 already asserts the receipt after-version timestamp equals the actual database timestamp. The timestamp mutant targets a different behavioral contract; it proves neither a fake state test nor a product regression. The survivor is reclassified inconclusive/oracle, not globally equivalent; no new assertions or test changes are authorized.
